meta.purpose: Replace all sprite PNGs with new high-quality art while keeping every semantic asset key and file name.
meta.styleGuide: clean cel-shaded sticker-style chibi game art in a cozy retro cartoon look, ONE thick even dark-navy outline (about 4 px at 512 px size) with smooth rounded curves, flat solid colors with simple soft shading, warm palette (terracotta orange, mustard yellow, deep navy, forest green, cream), NO fur or hair texture, NO individual hair strands, NO thin whisker lines, NO painterly noise; big readable shapes that survive being shown at 100 px on a phone, matching the attached style reference sheet

characterCanon.Anton (hero): adult man in his 30s, chibi proportions (head about 40% of body height), messy curly auburn-brown hair, rectangular black-rimmed glasses, short trimmed beard, dark navy-black hoodie with white drawstrings, blue jeans, dark sneakers with white soles
characterCanon.Masha (Player 2): adult woman, chibi proportions identical to Anton, long wavy golden-blonde hair, round black-rimmed glasses, the same dark navy-black hoodie as Anton, blue jeans, dark sneakers with white soles
characterCanon.Lapka (cat): small fluffy jet-black kitten, very round head, big round golden-yellow eyes, pink inner ears and nose, short tail, soft fur texture

forbidden: no text, letters, numbers or watermark anywhere (except where the description explicitly says a generic symbol)
no frame, border, rounded tile, card background or panel behind the subject
no checkerboard / transparency-grid pattern, no gradient or textured background
no ground shadow, floor, cast shadow or reflection
no second character or neighbouring item unless the description asks for it
do not crop the subject: every part (hair, tail, tips of ears, flame, wings) must be fully inside the canvas
no extra props that are not in the description
keep the same face, hair, glasses, beard and outfit across all images of the same character
meta.keyingNote: Generate on flat chroma background; scripts/import-sprites.py removes it, de-spills edges and writes transparent PNGs. Glow effects/ "effect_*" use black background and are converted by luminance.
